captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: So, let's say there's a Twitter user...

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: crying, and running from the void.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And let's say Jesus appears...

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Now.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And he sees all of this.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: So Jesus walks right up to the void,

captions.speaker: USER
captions.text: Uh. Sir? That's the void.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: puts his arm around it,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: and starts whispering in its ear.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: (whispers a joke)

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Nobody knows what he said. I have theories.

captions.speaker: VOID
captions.text: (HA!)

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And then the void starts laughing. Maniacally.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: So hard, it's coughing up stars...

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: and little galaxies.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Then Jesus looks at the Twitter user,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: who's, like, on their ass, with their hand up,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: and terror in their eyes.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: The void's got a pretty good sense of humor.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: Tee-hee.

captions.speaker: USER
captions.text: What the actual f***?!

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Now the void whispers into Jesus's ear.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And the whole time,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: it's side-eyeing the Twitter user.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And Jesus is just nodding along.

captions.speaker: VOID
captions.text: (a slower whisper)

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: No, I know. That hurts.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: I'll ask.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Then the void crosses its arms,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: and scowls at the Twitter user.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: The void says it wants to talk to you,

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: about something important.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: Do you have a moment?

captions.speaker: USER
captions.text: Hell no.

captions.speaker: USER
captions.text: I'm not talking to that scary thing.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: So the void rolls its eyes,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: huffs, and puffs,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: and turns its back on the Twitter user.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: In fairness to the void, it hears that a lot.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And Jesus gets that look on his face.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: Oh, boy.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: This is kind of awkward.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: So Jesus puts his hand on the void's shoulder.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: Hey. It's okay.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: You don't have to talk to the void.

captions.speaker: USER
captions.text: Wasn't planning on it.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: Fair.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: You were crying before it ever showed up, you know.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: But what about talking to me?

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: And it doesn't have to be about the void.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: It can be about you,

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: and the emotions that you're feeling.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: Because I want to talk to you more about emotions!

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: Because that's meaningful to me!

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: How does that sound?

captions.speaker: USER
captions.text: I just...

captions.speaker: USER
captions.text: Nope.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And then the Twitter user gets up, and storms off.

captions.speaker: USER
captions.text: Way. Too. Intense.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And blocks Jesus. On Twitter.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: For talking about the void, too intensely.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And Jesus looks back at the void,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: and shrugs.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And the void pats him on the shoulder,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: with a sad little smile.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: Too intense. Apparently.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: So Jesus puts his arm around the void,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: and they walk off, toward the horizon.

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: So a neutron asks the bartender, how much for a drink?

captions.speaker: JESUS
captions.text: For you? No charge.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Jesus, smiling a bit, telling it more dumb jokes,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: and the void, slightly giggling, in the distance.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Not yet. But maybe.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Okay. Bonus scene.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Now I'm imagining, when the void opened up the cage,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: to my fear...

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: that right behind the big body of the void,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: the depression magician was lurking.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: With its dagger, and its numbing dust, ready.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And it's, like, licking its lips, going,

captions.speaker: MAGICIAN
captions.text: Ooh. Fear looks very juicy.

captions.speaker: MAGICIAN
captions.text: Can't wait to knock Fear out.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And the void can see it.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Just, in the corner of its eye.

captions.speaker: VOID
captions.text: (a low, warm hum)

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: But instead of shouting,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: or making it obvious to my fear,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: that there's a creepy magician trying to stab it,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: the void just...

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: kicks the magician in the chest,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: with its fat leg.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And the magician goes flying, right into

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: the buckets and the cleaning supplies,

captions.speaker: MAGICIAN
captions.text: ...How rude.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: What's... what's that noise?

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And the void just shrugs.

captions.speaker: VOID
captions.text: (innocent hum)

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: Oh. ...Okay.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And then it goes right back to

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: showing my fear the galaxies.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And the nebulae.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: Why are you showing me this?

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: To distract my fear, from the fact that the void

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: had to kick the depression magician in the chest,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Just so it could have a moment,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: with my fear.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Tee-hee.

titles.text: The Void Has a Sense of Humor
